# tissue_mast_rotation (Resource)

An on-call rotation (a schedule, in the API). People in `order` take turns, handing off at `handoff_time` in `tz`. Point a policy step at it to page whoever is on call.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tissue_mast_person" "ana" {
  email = "ana@example.com"
}

data "tissue_mast_person" "ben" {
  email = "ben@example.com"
}

resource "tissue_mast_rotation" "primary" {
  name         = "primary"
  handoff      = "weekly"
  handoff_day  = 0
  handoff_time = "09:00"
  tz           = "Europe/Berlin"
  order        = [data.tissue_mast_person.ana.user_id, data.tissue_mast_person.ben.user_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The rotation's name.

### Optional

- `handoff` (String) How often the rotation hands off: `daily`, `weekly` (the default), `biweekly`, or `custom` with `length_hours`.
- `handoff_day` (Number) Day of a weekly or biweekly handoff, 0 for Monday to 6 for Sunday. Default 0.
- `handoff_time` (String) Time of the handoff, `HH:MM` on a 24-hour clock. Default `09:00`.
- `length_hours` (Number) Shift length for a `custom` handoff, 1 to 720. It is 0 for the other handoffs.
- `order` (List of String) User ids, in turn order. The first is on call from the day the rotation is made. Each must be a member of the account; `tissue_mast_person` looks them up by email.
- `tz` (String) IANA time zone the handoffs and overrides are read in. Default `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the rotation was made. Turns are counted from here.
- `id` (String) The rotation id, `sc_...`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name, when it's unique, or by id.
terraform import tissue_mast_rotation.primary primary
terraform import tissue_mast_rotation.primary sc_8d02e61b9f4c4e07
```
